paragraphs.text: Chandler was a human on Ulgrotha .

Chandler was one of the best-known rogues in the Homelands. He was a con man who had visited every city and village of the Homelands ever since he was old enough to travel the roads. Born with a knack for scams, Chandler was obsessed with liberating magical toys and mechanical devices from their owners. His preferred target was the Wizards' School on the Floating Island . The Wizard Savant of the Wizards School had placed a good-sized bounty on Chandler's head since the thief stole a ring of keys that were useful in altering and changing the mechanisms of clockwork creatures . While Chandler was at large, no artifact creature was ever safe.

Chandler sold his stolen goods to an anonymous buyer for high prices, but he didn't know that he was indirectly working for a minion of Baron Sengir , who was collecting many of these devices in preparation for his day of triumph.

Sometimes Chandler worked together with Joven , his partner in crime. The two were wanted not only by the Wizards School but by Eron the Relentless too since Chandler and Joven tricked Eron into giving them his prized Ebony Rhino . If Eron ever caught Chandler or Joven on his side of Strongrock , he'd make them pay for a very long time.
Given that hundreds of years have passed since his natural lifetime, it is likely that Chandler is long dead.
